sloka: पीतेन एकेन सम्वीताम् क्लिष्टेन उत्तम वाससा ।सपन्काम् अनलम्काराम् विपद्माम् इव पद्मिनीम् ॥५-१५-२१॥
transliteration: pītena ekena samvītām kliṣṭena uttama vāsasā ।sapankām analamkārām vipadmām iva padminīm ॥5-15-21॥

translations.english: She was wearing an excellent single yellow cloth which was soiled. Unadorned, she looked like a muddy lotuspond bereft of lotuses.
